market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected. Fed rate-hike pressure from 162K jobs print, geopolitical energy shocks, and Barclays' September de-risking call create headwinds. Memory/semiconductor names and defense provide relative strength. Bond markets face two-way volatility from Japan intervention and US rate expectations. Oil/diesel at all-time highs sustain energy inflation. Net: cautious, selective, favor quality and momentum over breadth.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and memory supercycle extend into 2027, supporting tech earnings. Defense spending structurally elevated. China's capital injection stabilizes Asian financials. Housing affordability crisis persists with rising mortgage rates. Geopolitical fragmentation (US-Canada, Iran, Ukraine) keeps energy and defense premiums embedded. Fed tightening may peak by Q1 2027, creating a late-cycle entry point for equities.
